unnamed_1: Okay, NOW Season 38 is the TRUE latest season of the race, filmed in March and April of 2025. Again, we are moving further away from being a "COVID" season as no travel was affected. However, this season is known as a "European Adventure" where all countries traveled to were in Europe - besides the final leg. Also, this season exclusively featured teams comprised of one Big Brother alumni and their travel partner.
- This season had the first instance of a triple U-Turn
- The Hazard returned this season on Leg 1
- The "penalty" for the non-elimination leg was an extra vote during the U-Turn Vote
- Teams started the race in Hoorn, Netherlands (not the USA)
- All legs were raced in Europe, except for the last
- This is the 3rd season with only one non-elimination leg
- Not a new country, but they haven't been to Romania since Season 14
